Name: Floral Drinks
Author: Lavliette
Description:
[center][b][size=5][i]Floral Drinks 

[/i][/size][/b]Don't know what to do with all your flowers? 
Why not turn them into Drinks? It's simple and delicious!

[b]How does it work?[/b]
Just collect five flowers and use the Crafting Menu to quickly turn them into a flowery drink.
The drink is worth 10x the base price, so save your high quality flowers for your machines and turn the low-quality ones into drinks!
(btw different colors don't matter at all as long as it is from the same flower)
